theorem lg_target (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (h : x + y = 2) : x * y ≤ 1 := by
  have hxy : x ≤ 1 := by rw [h]; exact (Real.le_div_iff hx hy).2 (le_rfl)
  have hyx : y ≤ 1 := by rw [h]; exact (Real.le_div_iff hy hx).2 (le_rfl)
  constructor
    · exact (Real.mul_le_mul_left (Real.sqrt_nonneg 1) (Real.le_sqrt hx (Real.pow_self_one 1))).trans (Real.mul_le_mul_left (Real.sqrt_nonneg 1) (Real.le_sqrt hy (Real.pow_self_one 1)))
    · exact (Real.mul_le_mul_left (Real.sqrt_nonneg 1) (Real.le_sqrt hx (Real.pow_self_one 1))).trans (Real.mul_le_mul_left (Real.sqrt_nonneg 1) (Real.le_sqrt hy (Real.pow_self_one 1)))
